title: Capitals of Oceania
intro: Pick the capital city of each country in Oceania.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Papua New Guinea?
questions.explain: Port Moresby is the capital of Papua New Guinea.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of)?
questions.explain: Palikir is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of).

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Tonga?
questions.explain: Nukuʻalofa is the capital of Tonga.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Vanuatu?
questions.explain: Port Vila is the capital of Vanuatu.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of New Zealand?
questions.explain: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Solomon Islands?
questions.explain: Honiara is the capital of Solomon Islands.
